usage: llm-modelbench capability-evidence [-h] [--json] [--mock]
                                          [--runtime-profile RUNTIME_PROFILE]
                                          [--runs-dir RUNS_DIR]
                                          [--campaigns-dir CAMPAIGNS_DIR]
                                          [--reprobe-required-only]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json                write the full machine-readable report to stdout
  --mock                use offline stub model list
  --runtime-profile RUNTIME_PROFILE
                        saved runtime profile; explicit selection takes
                        precedence
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR   root directory to scan for capability_report.json
                        (default: runs)
  --campaigns-dir CAMPAIGNS_DIR
                        root directory to scan for campaign evidence (default:
                        campaigns)
  --reprobe-required-only
                        in text mode, list only cells that need a reprobe
